digest.component_or_area: Pass-1 chunk and agent pool (LLM plan review)
propositions: With cold cache, submitting all chunks and agent futures concurrently to a 6-wide pool causes the first ~6 calls to each perform redundant cache-writes of the identical plan-bearing system prefix, resulting in 7.9N effective tokens versus ideal 2.15N
The warm-then-fan-out pattern exists and is proven for container bins but not yet applied to the main Pass-1 pool

A single warm-up call should complete serially to write the shared-prefix cache before remaining calls fan out to the pool, triggered when estimated shared-prefix tokens >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS and call count >= 2
Non-systemic warm-call failures should degrade gracefully to direct fan-out, while systemic LLMUnavailableError should abort
With proper warm-up gating, the shared prefix should incur exactly one cache write and N-1 cache reads across multiple Pass-1 calls
